written: 2026-10-20, before any run whose numbers appear in results/ (train runs, plan runs, grid runs, library runs)
seen_before_writing: src/tworoom.py against stable-worldmodel's TwoRoomEnv: 20 episodes, 1,200 noisy-expert steps, largest position difference 0.
The noise-free expert reached 100 of 100 goals in each test split (at most 58 steps across rooms, 34 within).

One pilot of the lewm arm, seed 0, 1,000 steps (a third of the planned run), on MPS in 95 s: held-out prediction loss 0.018 after BatchNorm statistics were recomputed (0.26 before: the reason for lewm.recalibrate), probe R2 for (x, y) 0.93, effective rank 29.0 of 32, Spearman(latent distance, walk distance) 0.42, imagined position error 13.4 to 14.9 units over 6 blocks against 13.2 to 13.9 for the probe on real frames.

Planning with that pilot model on the first 15 tasks of each split: CEM 1 of 15 across rooms and 3 of 15 within; random shooting 6 and 11; gradient planner (10 starts x 100 steps, too slow; cut to 20 x 25 for the real runs) 2 and 9; CEM with the true world and a straight-line cost 5 and 15. On 8 same-room tasks CEM's plans cost about 45 while a straight-line plan cost 1.5 to 69: CEM stalls on a flat cost.

A smoke test of grid_terms.py on 30 arenas, seed 0, with 200 training steps for the new arms (6,000 for ema): agent-cell probe R2 ema -0.02, pldm 0.51, sigreg_idm 0.00, ema_plain 0.01; plan success 1, 2, 0 and 4 of 30.
The pilot run, its plans and the smoke test are deleted; none of their numbers is reported as a result.

expectations.E2: lewm (D = 32, lambda 0.1): probe R2 for (x, y) at least 0.9 and effective rank at least 20 of 32, in every seed.
expectations.E3: dim8 and dim192 also reach probe R2 of at least 0.9 in every seed.
expectations.E4: Spearman between latent distance and walk distance ranks dim8 > lewm > dim192 (mean of 3 seeds), with dim8 at least 0.1 above dim192.
expectations.E5: lewm: the imagined position after 6 blocks is off by at most 1.5 times the probe's error on the real frame (mean of 3 seeds).
expectations.E6: CEM with the true world and a straight-line cost: at least 95% within a room, at most 50% across rooms (the cost walks into the wall).
expectations.E7: lewm with CEM: 10% to 50% within a room, under 20% across rooms (mean of 3 seeds).
expectations.E8: Random shooting beats CEM on lewm within a room by at least 20 points (mean of 3 seeds).
expectations.E9: The gradient planner on lewm does worse than random shooting in both splits (mean of 3 seeds).
expectations.E10: pred_only with CEM does no better than random actions plus 5 points, in both splits.
expectations.E11: dim8 with CEM beats lewm with CEM across rooms by at least 10 points (mean of 3 seeds).
expectations.E12: Expert 100% in both splits; random actions at most 10% within a room and 5% across.
expectations.E13: Grid, arm ema, seed 0, reproduces module 25: 11 of 300 goals (3.7%) and agent-cell R2 -0.015.
expectations.E14: Grid, ema_idm: agent-cell R2 at least 0.5 and plan success at least 20% (mean of 3 seeds).
expectations.E15: Grid, ema_plain: agent-cell R2 stays under 0.1; the residual predictor alone is not what drops the agent.
expectations.E16: Grid, vc and pldm: agent-cell R2 at least 0.5 and plan success at least 20%; pldm at least as good as vc (mean of 3 seeds).
